network.title: Network Configuration
network.hostname_help: Name of the device on your local network

pool.title: Pool Configuration
pool.suggested_difficulty_help: Used to indicate a preference for share difficulty to the pool. Servers are not required to honour this request, even if they support the stratum method. (0 to disable)
pool.extranonce_subscribe_help: Indicates to the server that the client supports the mining.set_extranonce method. Required by some pools, check the pool documentation.
pool.certificate_placeholder: Enter or choose a certificate file (.pem, .crt, .cer)
pool.stratum_protocol_help: Select Stratum protocol version. Note: Not all pools support Stratum V2.
pool.sv2_channel_type_help: Extended Channels are recommended for external pools — the pool sends the coinbase template so the miner can verify it. Standard Channels should only be used with a locally deployed SV2 node or JD client.
pool.sv2_authority_pubkey_help: The pool operator provides this key to prove you are connecting to the real pool and not an impersonator. Without it, the connection is still encrypted but a man-in-the-middle attack could redirect your hashrate.
pool.sv2_authority_pubkey_placeholder: Enter base58-encoded authority public key (optional, e.g., 9auqWEzQ...)
pool.require_authentication_help: Refuse to connect unless the server certificate is verified against the Authority Pubkey above. Protects against the man-in-the-middle redirect described for the Authority Pubkey. When enabled without a key set, the miner will not connect.
pool.decode_coinbase_tx_help: Enable decoding of the coinbase transaction to show payout addresses. Disable when mining on non-Bitcoin chains.
pool.share_warning_help: Warn on the dashboard when your share of the coinbase reward is low. Disable for pools that pay miners directly through many coinbase outputs.

device.custom_settings_warning: Custom settings can cause damage and system instability. Only change these settings if you understand the risks of running outside designed parameters.
device.overheat_reset_hint: Reset Frequency and Voltage before clicking this button.
device.overclock_reset_tooltip: Return to safe preset values only

miner.pool_response_time_help: Time it takes for the pool to respond to a share
miner.hashes_help: Approximate number of your total accumulated hashes (personal mining effort).
miner.pool_response_batched_help: The pool acknowledged {count} shares in one batch; the time reflects the most recent share, so it may include the pool's batching window
miner.coinbase_value_help: Total value of transaction outputs in BTC. For non-bitcoin chains, disable 'Decode Coinbase Tx' in Advanced Pool Options.
miner.coinbase_others_help: Further payout outputs, not listed individually
miner.coinbase_fee_help: Percentage of the bitcoin block reward that will be paid out to the pool if you find a block.
miner.coinbase_share_help: Percentage of the bitcoin block reward that will be paid out to your address if you find a block.
miner.hash_error_help: Hash error percentage as reported by the ASIC. A small amount of errors every few seconds is normal. Frequency changes, agressive overclocking, undervoltage or a bad power supply can significantly increase the error rate.

update.firmware_integrity_help: Compares the SHA-256 of the running firmware with the official esp-miner.bin of the same release.
update.no_release_found: No official release found for {version}. This is likely a development or custom build.
update.no_digest: The {version} release does not provide a checksum for esp-miner.bin.

Above target.label: Above target
Above target.explanation: The submitted share does not meet the minimum required difficulty.

Authorization validation error.label: Authorization validation error
Authorization validation error.explanation: The credentials provided by the miner were incorrect or not authorized.

Configuration validation error.label: Configuration validation error
Configuration validation error.explanation: Invalid mining configuration or settings sent by the miner.

difficulty-too-low.label: Difficulty too low
difficulty-too-low.explanation: The submitted share does not meet the minimum required difficulty.

Duplicate.label: Duplicate
Duplicate.explanation: This share has already been submitted.

Duplicate share.label: Duplicate share
Duplicate share.explanation: This share has already been submitted.

Invalid array size.label: Invalid array size
Invalid array size.explanation: The JSON array parameters had an unexpected size.

Invalid authorization message.explanation: The miner's mining.authorize request was malformed.

Invalid Bitcoin address.explanation: The submitted username is not a valid Bitcoin address.

Invalid configuration message.explanation: The miner's mining.configure request was malformed.

Invalid JobID.label: Invalid JobID
Invalid JobID.explanation: The job ID in the submission was not recognized or is no longer valid.

Invalid nonce2 length.label: Invalid nonce2 length
Invalid nonce2 length.explanation: The nonce2 value does not match the expected length for this mining job.

Invalid subscription message.explanation: The miner's mining.subscribe request was malformed.

Invalid version mask.label: Invalid version mask
Invalid version mask.explanation: The version mask provided was invalid for this job.

invalid-channel-id.explanation: The SV2 channel ID in the share submission is not known to the pool.

invalid-job-id.label: Invalid JobID
invalid-job-id.explanation: The job ID in the submission was not recognized or is no longer valid.

Mining Submit validation error.label: Mining Submit validation error
Mining Submit validation error.explanation: The submitted mining work was invalid or improperly formatted.

No job_id.label: No job_id
No job_id.explanation: The submission did not specify a job ID.

No nonce.label: No nonce
No nonce.explanation: The share submission was missing a nonce value.

No nonce2.label: No nonce2
No nonce2.explanation: The submission did not include the nonce2 value.

No ntime.label: No ntime
No ntime.explanation: The submission was missing the network time (ntime).

No username.label: No username
No username.explanation: The submission was missing a username (worker name).

Not subscribed.explanation: This connection has not subscribed — submit mining.subscribe first.

Ntime out of range.label: Ntime out of range
Ntime out of range.explanation: The provided ntime value was outside the allowed range.

Params not array.label: Params not array
Params not array.explanation: The parameters field was not formatted as a JSON array.

Stale.label: Stale
Stale.explanation: While this share was being submitted, the network had already found a new block, making this share invalid.

Subscription validation error.label: Subscription validation error
Subscription validation error.explanation: The miner's subscription request was invalid or malformed.

Suggest difficulty is disabled for this.explanation: This pool port does not allow miners to suggest a difficulty.

Suggest difficulty validation error.label: Suggest difficulty validation error
Suggest difficulty validation error.explanation: An invalid difficulty value was suggested by the miner.

Unauthorized worker.explanation: This worker has not been authorized — submit mining.authorize first.

Valid.label: Valid
Valid.explanation: This is not a rejection reason - it indicates a valid share.

Worker mismatch.label: Worker mismatch
Worker mismatch.explanation: The worker name sent does not match the expected or authenticated worker.
